TITLE: CYBER; Cyber Security for Consumer Internet of Things: Baseline Requirements
Scope: Transposition of TS 103 645 v3.1.1 into an updated version of EN 303 645, with implementation of feedback received on the TS. Specifically the updates focus on changes to gaps in clause 6 and testability in both clauses 5 & 6.

TITLE: CYBER; Cyber Security for Consumer Internet of Things: Baseline Requirements
Scope: Transposition of TS 103 645 v1.1.1 into an EN, with implementation of feedback received on the TS.

TITLE: Cyber Security (CYBER); Mapping of specific requirements of standardisation request for RED articles 3(3)(d), 3(3)(e) and 3(3)(f) to IEC 62443-4-2 requirements and to ETSI EN 303 645 provisions
Scope: Detailed mapping tables are provided to show which security requirement and provision from the IEC 62443-4-2 and the ETSI EN 303 645, respectively, covers which specific requirement from the standardization request for the RED articles 3(3)(d), 3(3)(e) and 3(3)(f). Hence, every single provision and requirement of both standards - IEC 62443-4-2 and EN 303 645 - is mapped to every single specific requirement written in the standardisation request for the RED articles 3(3)(d), (e) and (f).
